evidence_quotes.quote: AMD Ryzen 9 8945HS (Hawk Point, 8 Cores / 16 Threads, 4.0 GHz base / up to 5.2 GHz max boost, AMD Radeon 780M 2800 MHz iGPU, integrated Ryzen AI NPU up to 16 TOPS).

Minisforum UM890 Pro features Cold Wave 2.2 cooling supporting up to 70W TDP Performance Mode (~43 dBA peak noise), 19V/6.32A 120W DC adapter (plus USB4 65-100W PD input), dual 2.5GbE RJ-45 LAN, and OCuLink PCIe 4.0 x4.
Chassis dimensions 130 x 127 x 60.6 mm, net weight ~709 g, dual DDR5-5600 SO-DIMM slots (max 96 GB), dual M.2 2280 PCIe 4.0 SSD slots (1 slot occupied when OCuLink adapter card is installed).

adversarial_checks: OCuLink M.2 slot trade-off verified: Confirmed UM890 Pro implements OCuLink via an M.2-to-OCuLink adapter board occupying the second M.2 2280 NVMe slot—surfaced prominently in EN/KO local_gotchas.
Power & acoustics consistency check: Confirmed wall draw hierarchy 8.5 W idle <= 42 W typical <= 90 W peak stress (within 120 W brick envelope) and acoustic hierarchy 28 dBA idle <= 43 dBA 70W load.
SM-02 & Korea 220V check: Benchmarked 32GB/1TB configuration at $699 USD / 969,000 KRW under msrp_benchmark_mode with asin: null, noting 100-240V 120W brick compatibility and KR customs VAT.
